meta.title: A School Day at the Science Museum

paragraphs: On Thursday after lunch, Lily and May stood in front of the big calendar in the library. Teacher Kim had a note in her hand. The library was quiet. "Next Wednesday, the Explorers will visit the science museum," she said. "It is a school day, so please wear your uniform." "Why a uniform?" asked Leo. "On Saturday trips, we wear our own clothes." "A trip on a weekday is part of school," said Teacher Kim.

"What time does the bus leave?" asked May. "At a quarter past eight, from the school gate," said Teacher Kim. Lily wrote the time in her notebook. "How long is the ride?" she asked. "It is forty-five minutes, and we will come back at half past two." Lily nodded. Lily marked the day on the calendar with a red circle.

"How much is the ticket?" asked Leo. "It is free," said Teacher Kim, "because it is a school visit." "What must we bring?" asked May. "Bring a bottle of water, a notebook, and your lunch," said Teacher Kim. "Will there be a guide?" asked Lily. "Yes, Guide Ann will show us the museum," said Teacher Kim. May smiled.

On Wednesday, the bus arrived at the museum at nine o'clock. The museum was big and new. Guide Ann waited at the entrance with a name badge on a cord. "Welcome to the museum," she said. "The museum is open on weekdays from nine o'clock to five o'clock." "Today there is an international exhibition about the planets." "Scientists from twelve countries sent these photos." "Our tour starts at ten o'clock, so please stay together."

The children followed Guide Ann into a big dark room. Photos of the planets were on the walls. The photos were beautiful. Everybody looked up. "This is the biggest planet," said Guide Ann. "Can I take a photo with my small camera?" asked Leo. "Yes, but please turn off the flash," she said. Leo took three photos. Lily found the way to the exit easily, because the signs were clear. At half past two, the bus came back to the school gate. That evening, Lily put a green tick on the red circle in the calendar.
text.summary: Teacher Kim gives the Explorers the times and the rules for a weekday trip to the science museum. On the day, Guide Ann tells them about an international exhibition.
